checks.detail: Both reviewed files parse as UTF-8 JSON at the recorded byte counts and SHA-256 identities. Provenance binds the exact oracle, all accepted authority inputs, and all six active schema identities without mismatch.

Author codex.clean-room.semantic-oracle-author/v10 differs from the reviewer identity. The recorded authoring and correction times precede this review, and oracle plus provenance remain NOT_COMPARED with no product comparison.

The source and candidate execution inputs and retained transcripts use the exact closed property sets, constants, types, identifiers, active prompt tokens, enumerations, and bounded cardinalities of the six bound schemas. Expected axes and decisions are absent from the answer-free execution inputs.

Every source passage SHA-256, response-record fingerprint, zero-based UTF-8 citation span, exact extracted claim, and passage binding recomputes exactly. The contradicted source transcript has exactly one proposal and resolves one visible SHA-256-bound artifact that directly states the opposite proposition.

All source producer cases leave local applicability not evaluated and admit no local conclusion. Separate neutral, hash-bound consumer facts derive applicable, not-applicable, conditional-unestablished, unknown, and not-evaluated outcomes through full analysis-run application links.

Every candidate transcript resolves its exact execution context, candidate, hypothesis identity and unchanged hypothesis text. Supporting, insufficient, directly opposing, unavailable, abstained, and policy-rejected states are derivable from visible hash-bound artifacts and coherent source acquisition, admission, application, revision, and passage chains.

Explicit proposal abstention is abstained with both semantic axes not evaluated. Ordinary unavailable material abstains and is never audit-only; deliberate deletion is deleted, unavailable, not-evaluated, and audit-only. Rejection is confined to structural or policy failure with both axes not evaluated.
The five support states cross the five applicability states in exactly 25 unique cells. Supported plus applicable is the sole admitted cell, and every other ordinary semantic cell abstains.

Every valid source producer, source consumer, source-to-candidate application, and candidate case carries exactly one full schema-shaped decision link for that case. The zero-link probes are empty, and each two-link probe contains two individually valid, distinct full links so cardinality is the isolated defect.

All 17 invalid mutations have resolvable JSON pointers or valid array-add positions and independently exercise cardinality, admission policy, source-producer authority, unavailable/deleted policy, rejected-axis policy, closed tokens, contradiction cardinality/reference visibility, citation fidelity, content hashing, and active schema constants.

The package establishes only bounded public validation expectations. It creates no product input, registry or manifest authority, evaluator verdict, provider or credential authority, live-effect authority, reliability claim, or readiness claim.

closed_findings.closure: All six candidate cases now contain full 13-field analysis-run admissionLink objects, and both multiple-link probes contain two individually valid, distinct links of the correct source or candidate shape.
Each candidate evidence row now resolves one consistent source proposal through matching producer admission, consumer application, source revision, response, and passage identities.
The abstained transcript retains the exact execution-input hypothesis ID and text and expresses uncertainty only through the proposal state, reason, missing information, and abstention fields.

The visible opposition artifact now directly states that compatibility layer Z must not be enabled for build 7, opposing the cited instruction to enable it, and its SHA-256 binding recomputes exactly.
